purpose: Teach: ロク/オンリー/゛/トロツキー/健太郎/二郎/ロビン/みずほ

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: プロジェクト会議をロク、つまり六時に設定しましょう
lines.en: Let's schedule the project meeting for six o'clock.
lines.style: Efficient, direct. Slight upward lift on the time. No hesitation — this is settled. Professional but not cold. The tempo of someone moving through a list.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社のオンリーワンサービスをPRします
lines.en: Yes. I'll prepare materials highlighting our unique service offering.
lines.style: Eager to confirm. Steady affirmation on the opening. Thoughtful pace — he's already thinking ahead to execution. Supportive, not just compliant.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 文書の濁点、つまり゛の付け忘れに注意しましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure we catch any missing diacritical marks in the documents.
lines.style: Clear, instructional. Slight emphasis on the caution. Even tone — routine but important. The voice of someone who's seen this mistake before.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員勉強会にトロツキー思想史も加えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll add Trotskyist theory to the staff study session curriculum.
lines.style: Dutiful acknowledgment. Slight pause before the addition — he's taking it in stride. Steady, no raised eyebrow. Professional acceptance of an unexpected request.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新入社員の健太郎くんの配属を決めましょう
lines.en: Now let's decide on the department assignment for our new hire, Kentaro.
lines.style: Moving forward in the agenda. Even, purposeful tone. Small warmth on his name — acknowledgment of the person behind the task. Methodical.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。提携先の鈴木二郎様との会食を予定します
lines.en: Understood. I'll arrange the dinner meeting with Suzuki Jiro from our partner company.
lines.style: Confirmatory and specific. Clear articulation of names and details. Competent, attentive tone. The reassurance of someone taking careful notes.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 海外コンサルロビン氏の来日対応を整えましょう
lines.en: Let's organize the arrangements for our overseas consultant Robin's visit to Japan.
lines.style: Directive but collaborative. Slight emphasis on 'organize' — this needs coordination. Professional warmth. The tone of delegating something important but manageable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。みずほ銀行の融資条件を確認します
lines.en: Yes. I'll confirm the loan terms with Mizuho Bank.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Calm, assured closing. Steady pace — this is the last point and he's ready to move. No flourish, just competence.
